# codigate_service_token (Resource)

A service token that lets machines reach protected apps without a login. Attach it to an app with codigate_app.service_tokens. Tokens cannot be changed: every change creates a new token. Secrets and generated keys are only known to Terraform when it creates the token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "codigate_service_token" "ci" {
  name            = "CI"
  expires_in_days = 90
}

resource "codigate_service_token" "scanner" {
  name = "Scanner"
  type = "certificate"
}

output "ci_secret" {
  value     = codigate_service_token.ci.secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Token name (at most 100 characters).

### Optional

- `certificate` (String) For type certificate: your own client certificate (PEM). Leave out to have Codigate generate a key and certificate.
- `expires_in_days` (Number) Days until the token expires (1-3650). Leave out for no expiry.
- `type` (String) secret (default): a client secret sent as Codigate-Client-Secret. certificate: a client certificate (mTLS).

### Read-Only

- `cert_expires_at` (String) Certificate expiry (RFC 3339).
- `cert_sha256` (String) SHA-256 fingerprint of the certificate.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `expires_at` (String) Token expiry (RFC 3339), null for none.
- `generated_certificate` (String, Sensitive) For type certificate: the client certificate (PEM).
- `id` (String) Token id (svc_...), sent as Codigate-Client-Id.
- `pkcs12` (String, Sensitive) For a generated certificate: certificate and key as PKCS#12, base64.
- `pkcs12_password` (String, Sensitive) Password of pkcs12.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) For a generated certificate: the private key (PEM).
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Client secret (cgs_...) for type secret.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import codigate_service_token.ci svc_0123456789abcdef
```
